answers.reason: The research associate holds no office and has no specified seat in the central senate.
Budget planning is a high-level round restricted to leadership and central administration.
Without an office or specified seat, a research associate is not automatically permitted to take part in an appointment committee.
A regular research associate without an elected office does not have an automatic seat on the faculty council.
Because the research associate holds no office and no seat is specified for them, they cannot take part in the study commission.
Examination boards are formal bodies where participation requires a relevant office or designated seat, which the research associate lacks.
Awarding faculty research grants is a higher-level decision not open to non-office-holding research associates who assist in projects.
As teaching staff who teach courses in the faculty, research associates are plausibly permitted to take part in working groups rewriting module descriptions.
Because the research associate teaches courses and assists in research, they are plausibly permitted to participate in selecting teaching laboratory equipment.
Planning the orientation week is a low-level operational task open to teaching staff like the research associate.
